name: Highway Police Chase: Car Racing Game
summary:
Experience the ultimate adrenaline rush in Highway Police Car Chase! Designed exclusively for Meta Quest, this immersive VR game puts you in the driver’s seat of a high-speed police car, chasing down criminals across busy highways.

Feel the thrill of realistic first-person driving as you weave through traffic, avoid obstacles, and perform daring maneuvers to catch escaping thieves. With multiple missions and increasingly challenging levels, each pursuit will push your skills to the limit.
